detail.title: How to contact support
detail.content: Need help? Connect with the Partner Center support team to get your questions answered! There are two ways to contact our support team: 1. [Contact us through email](https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/contact-us) 2. Submit a ticket through Partner Console - Login Required # Option 1: Contact us through email 1. To initiate a support ticket and receive email responses, all developers can use the **Contact Us** option available on TikTok Shop Partner Center: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6e4b249bda6e4042b0b9a3f7ae67a6f6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. On the following page, please provide us your contact details, a detailed issue description, and any relevant files and documents. The more detailed your description, the more efficiently our support team can provide timely assistance: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/72d85edf32d342d685575897bc0fcba9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 3. Once the support request is successfully submitted, you should receive an email confirmation from [partner-us.support@tiktokshop.com](mailto:partner-us.support@tiktokshop.com) (US Partners) or [partner.support@tiktokshop.com](mailto:partner.support@tiktokshop.com)(Non-US Partners). Subsequent replies and updates on the issue will also be communicated from the email address above: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ab331241e4f54dbea92fc1ac74eadc5b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 📌 Note: Please refrain from sending emails directly to partner-us.support@tiktokshop.com or partner.support@tiktokshop.com. If you send questions to this email address, our support team will not receive them. To ensure a seamless process, all inquiries must be submitted through the Contact Us form. # Option 2: Submit a ticket through the Partner Console 1. In the Partner Center Console, navigate to the **Help Center** located at the bottom of the left-hand navigation panel: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/38f5de10e7ae45b397d64cc2e564b29a~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 2. In the **Help Center**, select the option to **Get technical support**: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/5e946a86449841f9a7dde4775f7bee4c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Alternatively, you can also submit a ticket by clicking on the **TikTok Shop Partner** banner and selecting **Submit a Ticket** in the drop-down menu: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/7aad1af5a83a47b4bace7258a7d9a67f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 3. From the drop-down menu, choose the appropriate issue category: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6813c7b4621841d18cc6e177a8aac436~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 4. Please provide a ticket title, a detailed issue description, and any relevant files and documents. The more detailed your description, the more efficiently our support team can provide timely assistance: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/22ff61c6322d4f1295a3838c1e7baefe~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 5. Upon successful ticket submission, a confirmation will be displayed: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e0986d5f26af47dd99c8590f8318dcee~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 6. Navigate to the **Support tickets** page by returning to the **Help Center** and selecting **View my tickets**: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2aa00f8aa53b45b486b596c24d86ee8f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 7. When our support team responds, you can see the response on the **Support tickets** page. This page serves as a hub for tracking and managing all tickets you have opened. In addition, you can submit a new ticket directly from this page: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b6c5bfdcfc9b4556b7d323420ae52628~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Ticket response time guideline Once you've submitted a ticket, our support team aims to provide an initial response within 24 business hours, usually much sooner, to address your question. Our goal is to resolve your issue completely within 48 business hours. * **Initial Response:** Typically < 24 business hours * **Issue Resolution:** Target < 48 business hours Please note that these are general response time guidelines, and we always strive to address your needs as promptly as possible.

detail.title: TikTok Shop developer guide
detail.content:
Welcome to the Developer Guide for the TikTok Shop API.

The TikTok Shop API provides programmatic access to the TikTok Shop platform for TikTok Shop application and service integrators.

If you're just getting started, we recommend you start with the TikTok Shop API [Get started overview](/4n48cxi1/tts-developer-types). You can learn more about [Developer onboarding](/4n48cxi1/developer-onboarding), and how to get access to Seller data in the  [Authorization overview (202407)](/4n48cxi1/authorization-overview-202407).

We also have a full API reference section organized by TikTok Shop data domain:

   * [Seller API overview](/605hu9kk/seller-api-overview)
   * [Products API overview](/605hu9kk/products-api-overview)
   * [Order API overview](/605hu9kk/order-api-overview)
   * [Fulfillment API overview](/605hu9kk/fulfillment-api-overview)
   * [Logistic API overview](/605hu9kk/logistic-api-overview)
   * [Finance API overview](/605hu9kk/finance-api-overview)
   * All other domains are included in the "API Reference" tab.


For more details about how to integrate with each domain's API, we've created a set of use case guides to walk you through some common integration scenarios with code flow diagrams.

We also provide a full set of webhooks that your application can subscribe to and get notifications from the TikTok Shop platform. Learn more in the webhooks [Overview](/4n48cxi1/tts-webhooks-overview).

If you're looking for more information about including your application in the TikTok Shop App Store, see the [App development overview](/4n48cxi1/app-development-overview).
## Next steps
If you're new to the TikTok Shop API, the best place to start is the [Get started overview](/4n48cxi1/tts-developer-types).

detail.content:
# Latest Features | Estimated Launch Time | Description | | --- | --- | | 8/22/2023 | 1. Support selecting API version for testing.
2. Support platform key to call all read (GET) interfaces.
3. Keep the store authorization restrictions of the app consistent with the online store (i.e., if your app only has a certificate for the UK, it cannot authorize stores in other regions).
4. Skip regional restriction verification for sandbox stores and allow authorization. | # What is API Testing Tool? The API Testing Tool enables developers to efficiently access the exact request and response parameters directly on Partner Center. Developers can use the API Testing Tool to efficiently test APIs * Simplifies the calling of API request and response parameters. * Streamlines the testing and code-writing process by offering sample code for direct use. * Serves as a reliable means to test API responses. You can use the response as a guide to resolve development issues. # API Testing Tool Entry Points There are two entry points to API Testing Tool on Partner Center: * Go to **Partner Console >> Development Kits >> API Testing Tool** * Go to **Partner Center >> Development >> API Testing Tool** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d3684103477c4bb3a3d9f457c315ea70~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Using the API Testing Tool to test APIs To test APIs using the API Testing Tool, you can use an app key provided by our platform, or use the app key of your app. ## Using platform app key The platform provides developers who have not yet registered an opportunity to try our APIs without an app key. Using the platform app key, developers can test the basic API capabilities provided by the platform. 💡**The app key provided by platform only supports calling GET method APIs. Using the platform app key to call API, the API Testing Tool will not provide a demo of the request.** ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9e21eb8c8dd44ef9975d674b9e4a1402~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Using Developer's Own App Key After logging in, developers can choose to use an **App Key** from an app they created to test APIs. > ⚠️ **Important**: Before calling any API, you **must configure the API Scope** for your App Key and complete the authorization process. Only apps with the appropriate API access permissions can successfully call the API. ### Steps to Use Your App Key 1. Log in to the [TikTok Shop Partner Center Console](https://partner-sso.tiktok.com/account/login). 2. Go to **App & Service** and select your app. 3. In the **API Management** section, configure the required **API Scope**. 4. Complete the authorization process, so your App Key has access to the corresponding APIs. 5. Select the API you want to test and use your App Key to make requests. Only after completing these steps will your App Key be able to successfully call the corresponding APIs. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/c2371170c1bd43448520bf229e02d2a4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/738b36d9fe5742bc9973332a97eafe9e~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) The developer's own app key needs to get shop authorization when using the testing tool, either by using the authorization function provided by the tool or by following the platform [Authorization Guide](authorization-guide-202309) to get the access_token and backfill it to the test tool. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/1fda59c4387849929800a303c123519f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Tips for using the API Testing Tool | Tip | Description | Demo | | --- | --- | --- | | Document guide function | API documentation guidance has also been done in the API testing tool. | ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/37b9f831e52344e68d3f7f0993e0d9d5~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

## Incident Statistics ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/4c8b3ccaee914d95bc1824c41cbae9f6~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) TikTok Shop Incident Statistics are generated by integrating with TikTok's internal Quality Engine product through Quality Engine APIs. 👉 Note: Quality Engine is an internal order reconciliation system that compares [orders](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/order-api-overview) and [fulfillment](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/fulfillment-api-overview) statuses for TikTok Shop orders between TikTok Shop Seller Center and the external platform where the orders are synched and fulfilled by the seller. Quality Engine's order and fulfillment data reconciliation system proactively alerts sellers to orders that are already cancelled by the system for failing to meet [`shipping_due_time`](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/sla-information-now-available-in-orders-api) SLA due to issues in order synching or fulfillment from the external platform, or are at the risk of being cancelled by the system for failing to meet `shipping_due_time` SLA. In order to use Quality Engine Incident Statistics in Partner Center Developer Dashboard, and for maintaining the required Partner close rate for Incidents, it is recommended for all developers to integrate their TikTok Shop Developer Apps with Quality Engine APIs available here: [API Documentation - Quality Engine Order Data Exchange API](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/docx/A6qMdwPC5oESvkxLuffcAVMbnLc) There are two different types of Incidents for TikTok Shop Orders that developers and partners are alerted to, and must address and close using the Incident Feedback and Close Process in document below. ### A- LOC Incident Statistics A-LOC stands for "App Caused-Late Dispatch Rate TikTok Shipping Cancel Order Count": TikTok Shop Orders that are cancelled by the system for missing order `shipping_due_time` SLA, and are cancelled by the reason `system_cancel_order_reason_shipping_timeout` are counted in the system as A-LOC. It is important to prevent A-LOC orders as much as possible to avoid loss of order revenue for both sellers and TikTok Shop. TikTok Shop Partners are recommended to keep **A-LOC rate < 0.01%.** A-LOC rate for a specific period is defined as: ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ea37e40eabe5470b92ef036cb14b7739~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | **Rule ID** | **TTS Order Status** | **TTS Order cancel_reason** | **TTS Tracking number** | **External System Order Status** | External System Fulfillment Tracking Number | SLA | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A1 | Cancelled | system_cancel_order_reason_shipping_timeout | NULL | Order not present or sent to external platform from TikTok Shop | N/A | | | A2 | Cancelled | system_cancel_order_reason_shipping_timeout | NULL | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | = Null | | | A3 | Cancelled | system_cancel_order_reason_shipping_timeout | NULL | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | | | A4 | Cancelled | system_cancel_order_reason_shipping_timeout | != NULL | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | | ### Risk Order Incident Statistics A-LOC stands for "*App Caused-Late Dispatch Rate TikTok Shipping Cancel Order Count*": | Rule ID//Rule ID | TTS Order Status | TTS Tracking number | DTC Order Status | DTC Tracking Number | SLA | TTS Order cancellation_initiator | TTS Order cancel_reason | Not Existing Reason | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | R0 | On_hold | = Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | --- | --- | --- | ~~There is no 'not existing reason' or 'not existing reason' is in (FC-101,FC-102,FC-103,FC-104,FC-105)~~ | | R1 | Awaiting_shipment | --- | No orders//No related orders | --- | --- | --- | | There is no 'not existing reason' or 'not existing reason' is in (FC-101,FC-102,FC-103,FC-104,FC-105) | | R3
(Short Time Built-in for Reasonable) | Awaiting_shipment | = Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | = Null | system date >tts_sla - 1 Day
And tts_sla !=0 | --- | | | | R5 | Awaiting_shipment | = Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | --- | --- | | | | R2 | Partially_shipping | --- | No orders//No related orders | --- | --- | --- | | There is no 'not existing reason' or 'not existing reason' is in (FC-101,FC-102,FC-103,FC-104,FC-105) | | R4
(Short Time Built-in for Reasonable) | Partially_shipping | = Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | = Null | system date >tts_sla - 1 Day
And tts_sla !=0 | --- | | | | R6 | Partially_shipping | = Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | --- | --- | | | | R7
(Short Time Built-in for Reasonable) | Awaiting collection | != Null | There is an order (any status)//Order created in DTC platform | != Null | system date > TTS Order TTS_SLA | --- | | | To drop rules, but need to add Incident status, Expired , data drop database to support the export of A-LOC data//the rules below are new rules and it needs to update the process of incident with new status'Expired ', the new status should be stored into DB to support exporting A-LOC data. ### Incident Feedback and Close Process Quality Engine Incident Reason Code: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/660bf931cf5cc502e03007ca

detail.title: Seller Center development shops
detail.content:
# Seller Center Development Shops User Guide # Introduction Seller Center Development Shops offer developers the ability to easily and efficiently generate Test Seller Center accounts that can be used for testing and development of TikTok Shop APIs. These test accounts will replicate production Seller Center Accounts and provide access to all production features and functionalities. Seller Center Development Shops are created exclusively for each Partner Center account. The key difference between Seller Center Development Shops and Product TikTok Shop Seller Center accounts is that Development Shops can not be discovered by TikTok users in the regular TikTok Apps. Below are some examples of actions that can be tested and developed against in Development Shops ## Examples of actions in Seller Development Shops * Create products * Place TikTok Shop orders * Place orders within Seller Center Development Shops without payments * Explore TikTok Shop and TikTok Product discoverability and buying experience through Test Buyer accounts * Place order payments through Test Buyer accounts with real payments * Fulfill orders * Process returns and refunds * Extract financial statements and settlements for the shop * Enable customer messaging services # Supported markets and seller types Seller Development Shops are now available for **cross-border and local shops** in the JP, MY, PH, SG, TH, US, UK, and VN markets, and for local shops in the ID market. # Terminology Important terms that might be used in Seller Development Shops and its related documents. | Term | Definition | | --- | --- | | Seller Center Development Account | In the real-world, a TikTok Shop seller must have a Seller Center account to manage their e-commerce business with TikTok Shop. Inside Seller Center Development Accounts, you can create Seller Center test accounts and operate shops for testing purposes. The shops in these test accounts will have the same functions as real-world shops, with the only difference being that Development Shops can not be discovered by TikTok users in the regular TikTok Apps. Events triggered in Seller Center test accounts will also not affect the production or real Seller Center Account once it's live. There are two different types of Development Account. | | Core Function Account | Core test accounts do not require any actual
business information, TikTok account setup, or credit card information for developers to register and get started. Core function test accounts can only access Test Seller
Centers through a windowed view in the Partner Center, but will have access to all core
testing features related to
i) Products
ii) Orders,
iii) Fulfillment.
As core function test accounts and corresponding shops do not involve actual transactions and buying through a Buyer Test TikTok Account, functionalities related to finance APIs, account settlement, customer service etc will not be available. | | Full Function Account | Full function accounts require Business and Know your Customer (KYC) information to be used for development and testing. Full function accounts support testing through the Core Account features and through linked Buyer Test TikTok accounts. Setup must be fully completed before orders can be placed with credit cards. Full function accounts can access the Seller Center and all related features through the link provided in the Partner Center. Full Accounts can be used for development for all TikTok Shop feature and APIs such as customer service, settlements etc. | | TikTok Account | A term used to describe an account created in the TikTok app. A user can register a TikTok account with their email or phone number, and log into the app to watch short videos, live stream and browse online stores' products. | | Official Test TikTok Account | In the real-world, a seller can link a TikTok account to a Seller Center shop to act as the shop's Official TikTok Account. When linked, the shop's information will be displayed in the TikTok account. Other TikTok users can search for the shop's information through this Official TikTok account in the TikTok app.
Similar to real-world accounts, test shops also need to be linked with a TikTok account. These TikTok accounts are created normally inside the TikTok app. After linking to a test shop, they will be converted into an Official Test TikTok Account. After linking and account conversion, shop functions can be tested directly in the TikTok app. | | Buyer Test TikTok Account | In the real-world, TikTok users can shop for products and pay for orders in the TikTok app.
A buyer test account is a real TikTok account that has been converted into a test account. Seller Development Shops can convert real TikTok accounts into buyer test accounts after the developer links the account in the Partner Center. With a buyer test account, you can experience your TikTok Shop discoverability and PDP experience first hand. And also shop for products and pay for orders in your test shops. | | Shop Type | --- | | Onboarding Type | Onboarding type refers to the account entity type. In terms of functionality, there is no difference between individual and business Seller Center accounts. | # Set up overview In general, developers will need to create test data to validate an API integration. The majority of integration cases will require creating a product and creating an order. With these two types of data, a developer will be able to run through the majority of integration cases necessary to service a seller. In order to create this data, a developer will need access to the following assets. * Seller Center Core Function Account or Full Function Account * Official Test TikTok Account for Full Accounts * Buyer Test TikTok Account for Full Accounts After completing setup, the developer will be able to use Seller Development Shops to manage these assets and use them to create test data (products and orders and subsequent data such as finance data). # Core Function Account ## Core Function Account features for Developers * Core Function Accounts are easier to onboard for development since they require minimal business information to set-up and enable * Core Function Accounts do not require creation of Test TikTok Official and Test Tiktok Buyer Accounts to create data for orders and fulfillment integrations * Core Function Accounts do not require any payments or credit card information for data generation and integration testing * Core Function Accounts cannot be used to test integrations outside of Product listing, order updates, and fulfillment **IMPORTANT NOTE**: In **Core Account** mode, the sandbox provides built-in tools that allow you to directly advance the forward and reverse order status. As a result, some real production flows may be **inconsistent with** or **not fully aligned with** the online environment. We recommend using this mode **only for core functionality testing**. For any scenario that requires full-flow or detail-level verification, please use **Full Account** mode instead. ## Setting up a Seller Center Core Function Account 1. In Partner Center Console, go to **Development Kits > Development Shops**, click **Create test account**
2. Select **"Core Function"** 3. Select "**Shop Type"** "Local" for the targeting sellers in the local market 4. Provide an **"Account Nickname"** 5. **"Onboarding type"** can be individual or business (no difference in functionality) Wait for Seller Center Test Account to finish setting up. # Using Core Function Account to test your app ## Steps for entering test shops and authorizing apps with your test shops 1. From TikTok Shop Partner Center, go to **Development Kits** Sandbox, click Seller test accounts 2. In **Development Kits** -> **Sandbox -> Manage Account** Seller test account section, click **'Authorize app'** to install and test your app with the test shop
## Adding and Managing Products
Create your first product in the Core Test account by entering any and all required TikTok Shop product information. Once done hit **"Submit for review"** Or alternatively developers can start using the [Create API endpoint](create-product) to create Products for this Development Shop Developers can make, manage and verify changes to products through the "**Products**" tab inside the Core Account Seller Center.
Under **Products** developers can manage and view all product information such as: * Product Statuses * Product titles and descriptions * Product Images * Product SKUs * Product inventory * Product Prices **Note:** Please wait for products to be approved through TikTok Shop review processes before orders can be placed through the Buyer View for the order. ## Add Shipping Templates for Seller Shipping **Note: The below images and instructions are for the US. Menu options for the UK will be different.** For developers and partners looking to build API integrations which involve shipping and creating labels outside of the TikTok Shop Platform, it's recommended to explore and select the right shipping settings through the **"Orders"** tab on the Core Function Account. 1. Click on **Orders -> Shipping Options** in side Core Function Accounts 2. Select TikTok Shipping or Seller Shipping
3. If Seller Shipping is selected, click on **Orders->Shipping Templates** and set-up a shipping template that includes all buyer regions in the US/UK
For more information about TikTok Shipping settings and Seller Shipping settings, please visit our Seller Academy [link](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2921116620719915&role=1&course_type=1&from=search&identity=1) ## Buyer View The Buyer View allows developers to trigger test orders and test order data to develop against in their Core Function Account. ### Create Orders 1. To create test orders and test data in the Buyer view click on **"Create test order"**
2. Select the products for the test order. Only **3 products** can be included in a test order **Note: Only 'Active'** status products in the Core Function account will be available to use in test orders 3. Select the Shipping Option for the order. For more information about TikTok Shipping settings and Seller Shipping settings, please visit our Seller Academy [link](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2921116620719915&role=1&course_type=1&from=search&identity=1)
4. Once the test order is successfully placed, it will show up in the Buyer view with status **"On Hold"**. For more information about TikTok Order Statuses, please visit our API documentation or Seller Center Academy ### Cancel Orders Similar to creating test orders, developers can also trigger order cancellations on behalf of the buyer through the "**Cancel order"** functionality within Buyer view. For a test order to be available for cancellation, the order must be in status "On Hold" or "Awaiting Shipment"**.** 1. Find the test order in buyer view that is available for cancellation under the Action section
2. Provide cancellation reason to confirm test order as cancelled.
3. Once cancelled in the buyer view, the order will show un as Cancelled in the Seller view for the Core Function Account as well ### Request Refund Developers can also trigger order refunds and returns on behalf of the buyer through the "**Request Refund"** functionality within Buyer view. For a test order to be available for refund, the order must be in status "Awaiting Collection"**, "**In Transit", "Delivered". 1. Find the test order in buyer view that is available for returns under the Action section 2. Provide return reason to send a return request to the Core Function Account
3. Developers can respond to the Return Request from the Buyer through either API call or through the Core Function "**Orders" -> "Manage Returns"** section ## Orders Developers can make, manage and verify changes to test orders through the "Orders" tab inside the Core Account Seller Center. ### Manage Orders Developers can use the **"Manage Orders"** tab to: * Check and verify Order details and information * Fulfill test orders for both TikTok Shipping and Seller Shipping * Validate changes to test orders through the API for both TikTok Shipping and Seller Shipping * Trigger seller cancellations for test orders and test different cancellation reasons * Split test orders (through the API or Interface) * Combine test orders (through the API or Interface) etc. For more information on TikTok manages orders, please visit our Seller Academy [link.](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7774796412471041&role=1&course_type=1&from=search&identity=1)
### Manage Returns Developers can use the **"Manage Returns"** tab to: * Check and verify return details and information * Respond to return requests through both the API or Interface * Process the order return through both the API or interface etc. For more information on how TikTok manages returns, please visit our Seller Academy [link.](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6837901778454274&role=1&course_type=1&from=search&identity=1)
# Full Function Account ## Full Function Account features for Developers * Full Function Accounts include all features of Core Accounts but require valid and correct business information for set-up and enablement * Full Function Accounts will require complete TikTok Shop Seller Center set-up * Full Function Accounts can be linked to Test TikTok Official and Test Tiktok Buyer Accounts to understand TikTok Shop and Product discoverability and buying experience * Full Accounts can be linked to Test TikTok Official and Test Tiktok Buyer Accounts to create data for orders and fulfillment integrations with real payments and credit cards as buyers would do * Full Accounts provide a stand-alone tab or window access to Test Seller Center Accounts * Full Function Accounts can be used to develop and test all TikTok Shop API integrations ## Full Account: Buyer Experience and Product Discovery on TikTok Shop Since all Full Account Seller Center test accounts mimic production accounts, the developer must follow all production and real seller center set-up steps when interacting with the assets in their Full Account Seller Center Development Shop. **The only difference between the Full Account Seller Center Development Shop and Real TikTok Shop Seller Center account is that Development Shop can not be discovered by TikTok users in the regular TikTok Apps. The Full Account Seller Center Development Shop** In the normal production environment on TikTok Shop, a seller manages their products within their shop through Seller Center. To make these products visible on the TikTok app, the shop needs to be associated with an official TikTok account. The seller is required to provide a TikTok account and establish this link within Seller Center. Once linked, the TikTok account becomes the shop's official account, and a new tab associated with this account appears when users search for it on TikTok. All available products will automatically be displayed under this tab, allowing buyers to browse and make purchases, resulting in the generation of orders.
## Requirements for Full Function Accounts Before getting started with Full function accounts, please ensure the following steps are completed: * Create an app with API enabled in TikTok Shop Partner Center. * Depending on your Partner Center partner type, you may need to provide your business information when creating a Seller Center Full Function Account. The information provided must be real. * For developers that have not previously linked their Seller Center account in Partner Center, you must provide your business information when creating a Full Function test account. This is required by TikTok Shop's payment service provider Paypal and Stripe (for payment and payout functionalities). The payment accounts you created for Paypal or Stripe will not affect other business or personal accounts you're using. * Register at least two new TikTok accounts for testing purposes. As mentioned earlier, one will serve as the Official TikTok Account, and the other as the buyer test account. If you need to link multiple TikTok accounts, you'll need to create additional accounts for testing purposes. * If you are unable to provide the required information or create a Full Function Account for testing, please consider using Core Function Accounts instead ## Creating and setting up assets for Full Function Account **Test assets setup flow**
### Setting up a Seller Center Full Function Account 1. In Partner Center Console, go to **Development Kits > Sandbox**, click **Create test account**
2. Select **"Full Function"** 3. Select "**Shop Type"** "Local" for the targeting sellers in the local market 4. Provide an **"Account Nickname"** 5. Click "**Go to Seller Center"** and complete [Seller Center onboarding](https://shop-academy-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=10013682&role=1&identity=1) (If you are a seller developer and already have a TikTok Shop linked to your Partner Center account, you will not see this step) You need to provide business information to complete the onboarding. If some of the information provided fails to pass the review, we will notify you in both the Seller Center and the Full Function Account page in Partner Center. You'll need modify and resubmit the required information. For US and UK Seller Center test accounts, the following information must be submitted if you need to make full use of the functionality: * US: In order to publish new products in your test shop, you'll need to provide required tax information in the Seller Center. * UK: In order to receive payouts from TikTok Shop, you'll need to fill out the tax information for your Seller Center test accounts. * After creating test shops, default pickup warehouses will be set automatically. You will need to set shipping templates for the test shops. Learn more about how to [Set up shipping](https://shop-academy-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=10012875&role=1&identity=1) in Seller Center. * Provide and submit your tax information in Seller Center (US only). This step is required in order to publish products. ### Setting up an Official Test TikTok Account 1. Create a new TikTok account in the TikTok app. We recommend using an email address to create this account. Do not use any production TikTok accounts as your Official Test TikTok Account. 2. Link a TikTok account as your test shop's Official TikTok Account. Learn more about [how to link TikTok Shop Official Account](https://shop-academy-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=10012412&role=1&identity=1). Note: TikTok accounts can also be linked as Marketing Accounts in your test shop. For testing your apps, we don't recommend linking TikTok accounts as Marketing Accounts. There are more restrictions on Marketing Accounts regarding merchandise and shop visibility.
Note: * When creating the TikTok account, your physical location must be the same as the test account (shop) you created (i.e. You're physically located in the US and you're using a US test shop). Otherwise, when attempting to link the account, Seller Center will block you from linking. The TikTok account must be in the same region as the shop. * If you cannot physically be in the same location as the shop, please remove the sim card from your device and use a VPN to change your IP to the location of the test shop you created before creating the TikTok account. ⚠️ **Warning:** Once a TikTok account is linked in the Full Function Test Seller Center Account, it will be converted to a test account. This action is permanent and cannot be reversed. This account can not be used in the TikTok app or TikTok Shop production environment. It is "separated" from the real-world. The conversion will happen when the TikTok account is linked to your test shop's "Official TikTok Account" or when it is linked as a buyer test account in your Partner Center account. This will affect you in the following two cases: 1. If you have a TikTok account that has many followers and publishes video content, and you link the account to a test shop as the shop's Official TikTok Account, TikTok users will not see the TikTok account in the production environment. 2. If you use your personal email address to create a TikTok account and link the account in sandbox, this account will no longer be able to search for TikTok accounts or store products in the production environment. We strongly suggest using testing email addresses when registering TikTok test accounts for Full Function use. ### Setting up a Buyer Test Account (TikTok Account)
1. Create a new TikTok account in the TikTok app. We recommend using an email address to create this account. Do not use any production TikTok accounts as your Buyer Test Account. 2. Link a second TikTok account as a buyer test account. 1. Log into the TikTok app with the newly created TikTok account you want to use as the buyer test account. 2. In TikTok Shop Partner Center, go to Development kits > Sandbox > Buyer test accounts, click **Link account**. 3. Use the TikTok app to scan the QR code on the "Link TikTok account as buyer account" page and follow the "Authorize TikTok Partner Center" process on the TikTok app. 4. Click **Link the account** on "Link TikTok account as buyer account" page Note: * This is a separate account from the one you just created to be used as your Official Test TikTok Account. * When creating the TikTok account, your physical location must be the same as the test account (shop) you created (i.e. You're physically located in the US and you're using a US test shop). Otherwise, when attempting to link the account, Partner Center will block you from linking. The TikTok account must be in the same region as the shop. * If you cannot physically be in the same location as the shop, please remove the sim card from your device and use a VPN to change your IP to the location of the test shop you created before creating the TikTok account. Once a TikTok account is linked in the sandbox, it will be converted to a test account. This action is permanent and cannot be reversed. This account can not be used in the TikTok app or TikTok Shop production environment. It is "separated" from the real-world. The conversion will happen when the TikTok account is linked to your test shop's "Official TikTok Account" or when it is linked as a buyer test account in your Partner Center account. This will affect you in the following two cases: 1. If you have a TikTok account that has many followers and publishes video content, and you link the account to a test shop as the shop's Official TikTok Account, TikTok users will not see the TikTok account in the production environment. 2. If you use your personal email address to create a TikTok account and link the account in sandbox, this account will no longer be able to search for TikTok accounts or store products in the production environment. We strongly suggest using testing email addresses when registering TikTok test accounts for sandbox use. # Using Full Function Account to test your app Test shops created as Full Function Account have the same functionalities as shops in the production TikTok Shop environment. We list the most common shop operations for testing apps and its feature guide article from the [TikTok Shop Academy](https://shop-academy-us.tiktok.com/university/home). ## Steps for entering test shops and authorizing apps with your test shops 1. From TikTok Shop Partner Center, go to **Development Kits** Sandbox, click Seller test accounts 2. In **Development Kits** **Sandbox**, Seller test account section, click "Authorize an app" to install and test your app with the test shop ## Adding and Managing Products ### Add and Publish Products Add and publish products. In order for products to be published in the US, you must have submitted your tax info during the Seller Center test account setup stage. Note: * Please follow production rules when creating products. Do not add 'test' or random characters, or keywords that will get flagged by the system when creating products. Use real product names. ### Finding Products in TikTok After products are published, you can check the product by using the Buyer Test Account in TikTok and search for the Official Test Account. The products tab should display the products you've published. You will only be able to use the accounts you linked in TikTok to search for these products. Using any other accounts will not work. **Note:** * If you are not seeing your product after searching in TikTok, please make sure to first check to see if your published products have any un-allowed key words in the product's title. The product could have been flagged even if it shows published in Seller Center. * Make sure you're in the same physical location as the shop when searching. If you cannot be in the same physical location, remove the sim card from your device and use a VPN to change your device IP. ## Creating and Managing Orders ### Create Orders By default, your newly created test shops will not have any orders. If your app provides product management and order & fulfillment synchronization to sellers, you can follow the below steps: You need add a payment method to the Buyer Test Account (TikTok account) and pay for the test products with real money. Please set a very low price ($0.01) for test products. 1. Log into the Buyer Test Account in the TikTok app, find the test shop's Official TikTok Account by using the search function 2. In the TikTok app, from the Official TikTok Account's profile page, click **Shop** and enter the store page 3. From the store page, find the products you want to place orders with 4. Follow the TikTok app's purchasing process to complete the payment Note: * If you are getting any type of errors when trying to place an order (i.e. Something went wrong), please make sure you're in the same physical location as the shop when placing the order. If you cannot be in the same physical location, remove the sim card from your device and use a VPN to change your device IP. ### Manage Orders Once the order is paid, the order can be managed by going to **Seller Center - Orders - Manage orders**. You can fulfill the orders via API according to your app's test cases. For more details regarding order management, please check the TikTok Shop Academy articles below. * [Manage orders](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7774796412471041&identity=1) * [Manage seller arranged shipping](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6837882170099457&identity=1) * [Manage TikTok Shop logistics shipping](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=8706274700117762&identity=1) Note: * If you need to test order settlement, revenue sharing, and other functions, please make sure to use a **Full Function Account**. # Limitations 1. You can create up to 10 Seller Center **Full Function and Core Function Accounts**. That means you can concurrently use 10 test shops for different test cases. Furthermore, you are only required to submit your necessary business information for Full Function Accounts once. You won't be required to resubmit the same business information when generating additional Full Function Accounts. 2. Seller Center Development shops expire in 180 days but can be reactivated on Partner Center. 3. You can link up to 10 TikTok accounts as "buyer test accounts" to one Partner Center account. Buyer test accounts linked to the Partner Center account can be used with any of the test shops you create in Sandbox. 4. You need at least two real TikTok accounts - one for the Official TikTok account and another for the buyer test account in Seller Center Development Shops. Please note that you cannot simultaneously use the same TikTok account as both the Official TikTok Account for the test shop and as the buyer test account.

detail.title: Configuration guide
detail.content:
# Webhook configuration overview There are two ways to configure webhooks: you can configure on Partner Center or using the Event API. # Requirements * You're familiar with how [webhooks](tts-webhooks-overview) work. * You're [authenticated](sign-your-api-request) with the TikTok Shop API * You have the required permissions for the topics you're subscribing to. # Webhook URL Requirements * Employ the `https://` scheme * Use TLS v1.2+ * Webhook URL can only be a domain name, not an IP address, and it cannot have a port * Success returns 200, and authentication failure returns 401 # Method 1: Configure webhooks on Partner Center ## Step 1: Configure webhook URL on Partner Center 1. Add an HTTP Server URL in the '**Developing**' tab under '**Basic information**' to receive webhook notifications.
## Step 2: Decide what webhook topic to subscribe TikTok Shop Partner Center automatically subscribes your app to default webhook notifications. You can manage webhook subscriptions in the '**Developing tab**' to choose specific events and actions you want to receive notifications for.
## Step 3: Receive the webhook TikTok Shop sends an HTTP POST request to the URL specified every time that event occurs. The HTTP POST request's parameters contain the JSON data relevant to the event that triggered the request. TikTok Shop verifies SSL certificates when delivering payloads to HTTPS webhook addresses. Make sure your server is correctly configured to support HTTPS with a valid SSL certificate. To validate incoming webhook notifications, TikTok Shop includes a signature code in the 'Authorization' field of the HTTP request header. Developers should verify this signature, and instructions for generating it can be found [here](sign-your-api-request). ## Step 4: Respond to the webhook To confirm successful receipt of a webhook notification, the HTTP server url is required to provide a proper response to declare having received the notification successfully. Acceptable HTTP responses include the following below: | Header | Body | Response Interval | | --- | --- | --- | | 200 | NULL / empty | within 3 seconds for each notification | | 401 | NULL / empty | within 3 seconds for each notification | Failure to do so will result in a webhook push notification re-try from TikTok Shop. No further attempt will be made after the 4th retry failure. | Retry | Trigger | | --- | --- | | 1st Retry | 2 minutes after the initial push failure | | 2nd Retry | 30 minutes after the 1st retry failure | | 3rd Retry | 3 hours after the 2nd retry failure | | 4th Retry | 12 hours after the 3rd retry failure | # Method 2: Configure webhooks using Event API Here are the Event APIs you can use to configure webhooks: 1. [Update Shop Webhook](update-shop-webhook): Use this API to create a special webhook for a shop for a certain event. This is equivalent to step 1 and 2 if you configure webhooks in Partner Center. 2. [Get Shop Webhooks](get-shop-webhooks): Use this API to get all shop webhooks configurations 3. [Delete Shop Webhook](delete-shop-webhook): Use this API to cancel the webhook for a shop for a certain event # How to check webhook event history? TikTok Shop Partner Center also offers a portal for monitoring all webhook push logs, allowing you to debug and confirm the successful receipt of webhooks by your recipient URL server. To access this feature, go to **Partner Console >> Development Kits >> Webhook Log.** From there, select the specific app you want to view webhook logs for.

detail.title: Overview
detail.content:
Webhooks enable real-time HTTP notifications for TikTok Shop events and actions, transmitted securely over HTTPS to the subscribed HTTP server. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a7684affb194494c963ffde1f486a741~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) 1. The app subscribes to the `Order Status Update` topic for a shop and listens for order status update events 2. The app specifies an HTTPS endpoint hosted by the app server to receive events for the topic. 3. An order in the shop is created or the status has changed. 4. The event is published to the `Order Status Update` topic. 5. TikTok Shop sends the webhook with an order status upload payload to the registered subscription endpoint. ## Use cases Common webhook use cases include the following: * Receive a notification when order status has been updated * Receive a notification when the order recipient address has been updated * Receive a notification when return status has been updated * Receive a notification when product status has been updated ## Attention Due to possible network problems and other uncertainties, you cannot completely rely on webhooks. You must have business logic, such as pulling orders through scheduled tasks, etc. ## Webhooks Header and Body ### Header TikTok Shop Partners Center pushes notification to developers and places signature in the "**Authorization**" field of the http request header. The signature is generated with **HMAC-SHA256** and it should be verified by developers. Signature is generated as follows: 1. Suppose your app key is **abcdef**. 2. Suppose the webhook payload is: ```plaintext {"type":1,"tts_notification_id":"7380066284010030890","shop_id":"7495540735365777507","timestamp":1718305585,"data":{"is_on_hold_order":true,"order_id":"576653688135258178","order_status":"UNPAID","update_time":1718305585}} ``` 3. Concatenate {app key}{webhook payload} as signature base string with no formatting when pasting the strings: ```plaintext abcdef{"type":1,"tts_notification_id":"7380066284010030890","shop_id":"7495540735365777507","timestamp":1718305585,"data":{"is_on_hold_order":true,"order_id":"576653688135258178","order_status":"UNPAID","update_time":1718305585}} ``` 4. Suppose your app secret is **123** to use as the signing key. 5. Calculate the signature by passing the signature base string and signing key to the hmac-sha256 hashing algorithm. The resulting sign is: ```plaintext 5dec0f11ec2f6783b8deee53c9ffbf8d024302f7c7e7fa55a35d17629031ac05 ``` ## Body All webhook notifications from TikTok Shop will include the following payload parameters | Param Name | Sample | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | type | 1 | The identification of each type of notification | | shop_id | 123455 | The identification of the TikTok Shop | | timestamp | 1627587506 | The timestamp when the notification is pushed | | data | "data": {
"order_id": "1X2X3X4X5",
"order_status": "CANCEL",
"update_time": 1627587505} | The object contains business parameters related to the specific notification type. | ### Sample Sample curl request: ```JSON curl --location --request POST 'https://www.bing.com/webhook' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Authorization: 46c0d0a3299661dc92888f7da8ba2321f240e460e2b005389353432a1062b777'\ --data-raw '{ "type": 1, "shop_id": "7494049642642441621", "timestamp": 1644412885, "data": { "order_id": "576486316948490001", "order_status": "UNPAID", "update_time": 1644412885 } }' ``` ➡️ See a list of our webhooks [here](1-order-status-change)

path: TikTok Shop widgets/Overview.json

detail.title: Overview
detail.content:
# What is "widget"? Widget is a component that consists of a TikTok Shop-based API and UI interface, The Widgets support various seller use cases on TikTok Shop, such as setting warehouse/shipping templates, optimizing products, fulfilling the order, checking the performance data... What's the difference between API and widget? In summary, ***widgets*** are the visual components that enhance the user interface and functionality of a specific feature, while APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) are sets of rules and protocols that allow different software applications to communicate with each other, which do not include UI components. ## Technical Differences ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/65d2997cf794467e898e0a5658fd7436~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) | | TikTok Shop-API | TikTok Shop Widget | | --- | --- | --- | | Technical Architecture / Integration | API is a pure REST backend-to-backend integration. | The widget is an SDK that is integrated in your frontend. which take care of all the (backend) calls to the TikTok Shop. | | Development | Requires backend development. | Requires front-end development (excluding token integration). | | UI flexibility | You have full control over the frontend in your app. which is flexible and can be customized. | The Widget provides out-of-the-box interface for your users. which is easy to use and not customizable. | # What are the benefits of integrating widgets? * Widget is easy to integrate, which in most cases only costs frontend resources to integrate * Widgets can enhance the functionality and interactivity of your APP, providing additional value to users. * Widgets can provide consistency with data and interface from TikTok Shop API # How to integrate widgets? ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ee4bd621c9fc44eb8e9209eb35e9963b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) # Before you Begin ## Step 1 Browse widget options You can browse widget options on the ++Development kits> Widget ++tab and Partner Center doc center, click learn more to check more details about this widget. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9aa5d767a1d24bca93609b20f3c673ba~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/95321924572a40e890542d2bfd5638f9~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 2 Finish widget setting Developers can check a list of all apps that have been created and whether or not the app has enabled widgets. By clicking the configure button, the partner will jump the developer to the app details page for them to configure. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bdcb000f0508483ab81cd925b3f84872~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/f1f4c7b42b25489dabd2118aee2d3877~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Developers can also start widget pre-setting configuration on the APP details page when creating a new app. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2e4b5b8bdba1415f80ddc62ad95deedd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) Developers need to provide domain URLs for the widget. Please note: 1. Please provide a root domain, otherwise you may encounter the error message. 1. URL Example: https://demo1.tiktokshop.com 2. The maximum number of URLs you can add is 10. ![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/6aba7fe704ff4027905ece40bdca7423~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image) ## Step 3 Start integration After the presetting of the widget, you can now follow the widget integration guide to integrate with the widget and test your widget before launch. ## Authentication Token We provide you with a short-term token and you can refer to [Get Widget Token.](get-widget-token) # Widget integration Guide | NO. | Widget name | Widget intro | Widget demo | Market | 📒 Integration Guide | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | Warehouse widget | Before listing products, the seller is required to set up warehouse info.

* Seller may have no chance to know this information or set shipping template without logging to Seller center.
* High failure rate of API listing products is mainly caused by not setting shipping templates

Warehouse Settings widgets can enable the Seller to enter the delivery warehouse and return warehouse information, including warehouse contact person, warehouse address, and warehouse sales range. |
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/d95c979bca564e2aa3a6695787c00102~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| US&UK | https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/66599ca675ead002e4e0c3fb | | 2 | Shipping template widget | Before listing products, the TTS seller is required to set shipping templates if the seller chooses to ship by themselves.

* Seller may have no chance to know this information or set shipping template without logging to Seller center.
* High failure rate of API listing products is mainly caused by not setting shipping templates

For 3PL sellers, this widget can provide shipping template(Prerequisite for listing products) for Seller |
![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/ef6f928a3ada4fd6bafd0a8eb150c13c~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)
| US&UK | https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/66599c6d36f34802de23344e | | 3 | 🔥Product optimizer widget | After syncing the product, the low product info will continue to affect traffic and the seller may have no idea how to improve it.
This widget leverages AI-powered recommendations to produce high-quality product information and improve the seller's overall product performance.

![Image](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/bf0e583489ea45e69af30ab2713f84ad~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-image.image)

| US&UK | https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/66599c4236f34802de23338d | | 4 | 🔥Orders by TikTok Shipping (4PL)widget | For those sellers who use 4PL delivery, they need to carry out delivery actions in the TTS seller center after they check orders in the 3P app, which is time-consuming
This widget enables sellers to process 4PL orders individually/in batches in the 3P APP.
(select orders in batches - > > create labels - > > print labels - > > process shipments) |

detail.title: Widget SDK user guide
detail.content:
# Widget SDK Update instructions This article documents the changes to the <**Widget**> SDK. ## @tiktokshop/widget-kit For native js integration ### Release date:2024/2/19 Fixed some issues. ### ### Added | **modules** | **description** | | --- | --- | | init | Added init method to support user integration and initial widgets. | | loadWidget | Added loadWidget method to support users loading our widget page. | | update | Added update method to support users to modify widget config. | | preloadWidget | Added preloadWidget method to support users to preload widget resources. | ## @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react For React component integration ### Release date:2024/2/19 ### Added | **modules** | **description** | | --- | --- | | WidgetConfigProvider | Added WidgetConfigProvider component, the component integrates the original init, update, preload methods, WidgetConfigProvider should be used with RemoteWidget, it is recommended to use WidgetConfigProvider in the react integration scenario instead of directly calling init, update, preload. | | RemoteWidget | Added RemoteWidget component. The original loadWidget method is integrated inside the component. Load state placeholder map and abnormal state placeholder map are provided. Users can specify widgets, load resources and render components by name. RemoteWidget should be used with WidgetConfigProvider. It is recommended to use RemoteWidget in the react integration scenario instead of calling loadWidget directly. | ### ### Added | **modules** | **description** | | --- | --- | | init | Added init method to support user integration and initial widgets. | | loadWidget | Added loadWidget method to support users loading our widget page. | | update | Added update method to support users to modify widget config. | | preloadWidget | Added preloadWidget method to support users to preload widget resources. | # Quick start ## Configure development environment ### Frame adaptation We support two methods of react framework integration and native js integration. Users using the react framework can use the react component method to integrate, and non-react framework users can use the native JS method to integrate. ### Install dependencies To use react component integration, please install the following packages: ```JSON npm install @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react ``` For native js integration, please install the following packages: ```JSON npm install @tiktokshop/widget-kit ``` ## Integrated SDK ### Preconditions * The server needs to develop an API for obtaining short-lived tokens (refer to document [Get Widget Token](get-widget-token) for development methods). When the front-end integrates the widget page, during the initialization SDK phase, the getWidgetToken field is passed into the function to obtain the token. * For security reasons, there are cross-origin restrictions on the interfaces in the widget page. When integrating the widget, you need to provide the domain name to the open platform for whitelist configuration. ### Init widget react framework uses (recommended): It is recommended to put `WidgetConfigProvider` in the outermost layer of the entire application for global unified configuration ```TypeScript import { WidgetConfigProvider } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit-react'; const initOptions = { config:{ shopId: 'xxx', //seller id, such as 123456 oecRegion: 'xxx',//country,such as US appKey: 'xxx',//The key corresponding to the merchant's creation service isvInfo: { name: 'xxx',//ISV name,such as OPEN_PLATFORM }, }, getToken:getWidgetToken, // If you integrate multiple widgets, remotes can set multiple remotes:[ { name: 'xxx',//Integrated business name, provided by the open platform,such as:@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer }, ] }; export default () => { return ( ); }; ``` native JS uses: ```TypeScript import { init } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit'; init({ config: { shopId: 'xxx', //seller id, such as 123456 oecRegion: 'xxx',//country,such as US appKey: 'xxx',//The key corresponding to the merchant's creation service isvInfo: { name: 'xxx',//ISV name,such as OPEN_PLATFORM }, }, remotes: [ { name: 'xxx',//Integrated business name, provided by the open platform,such as:@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer }, ], getToken: getWidgetToken,//get auth token }); ``` ### Preload widget If the widget page is not displayed on the first screen, the resources can be loaded in advance by preloading, which can reduce the loading time of subsequent components and improve the page response speed. react framework uses: Configure preload in `WidgetConfigProvider` preloadWidgetNames, you can put `WidgetConfigProvider` to the outermost preload time ```JSON // For react component integration import { preloadWidget } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit-react'; export default () => { return ( ); }; ``` native JS uses: Preloading with `preloadWidget` ```JSON // For native js integration import { preloadWidget } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit';//Reference method depends on the selected integration scheme preloadWidget(['@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer']); ``` ### Load widget react framework uses: ```JavaScript import { RemoteWidget } from "@tiktokshop/widget-kit-react"; const name = "@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer"; export function Test() { return ; } ``` native JS uses: ```JSON import { loadWidget, WidgetComponent } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit'; //load widget const name = '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer'; let view = null; loadWidget(name).then((component: WidgetComponent) => { view = component.create( document.getElementById('widget-preview-container')!, ); view?.render({}); }); //create a mount element
``` ### Update widget config When the merchant's shop information needs to be modified, the shop and other information can be updated by using the update method. react framework uses: Update WidgetConfigProvider parameters to update widget configuration native JS uses: ```JSON import { update } from '@tiktokshop/widget-kit';//Reference method depends on the selected integration scheme update({ config: { shopId: 'xxx', //seller id, such as 123456 oecRegion: 'xxx',//country,such as US appKey: 'xxx',//The key corresponding to the merchant's creation service isvInfo: { name: 'xxx',//ISV name,such as OPEN_PLATFORM }, }, getToken: getWidgetToken,//get auth token }); ``` # Reference API ### Input Parameters | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | config | Object | Y | | basic config of widget | | shopId | string | Y | '123456' | seller id, used for event tracking | | oecRegion | string | Y | 'US' | seller region, fill in the standard code of the country where the merchant is located, such as 'US', 'GB', and so on. | | appKey | string | Y | 'xxxxx' | authorized by the service market, used for authentication | | isvInfo | Object | Y | | ISV related information | | name | string | Y | 'xxxxx' | the name of ISV | | getToken | Promise | Y | | promise method to get token | | token | string | Y | 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzUxMxxxxxxxx' | token | | expire_at | string | Y | '1703227531' | expiration | | remotes | []Object | Y | | | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | The output parameters of loadWidget in @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react and @tiktokshop/widget-kit are different. The specific differences are as follows: ### @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react #### Input Parameters | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | #### Output Parameters | Properties | Type | Sample | | --- | --- | --- | | Component
(custom name) | React.ComponentType | `JSON
const Component = loadWidget(name);
return (



);
` | ### @tiktokshop/widget-kit #### Input Parameters | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | #### Output Parameters | Properties | Type | Sample | | --- | --- | --- | | component
(custom name) | Promise | `JSON
loadWidget(name).then((component: WidgetComponent) => {
view = component.create(
document.getElementById('widget-preview-container'),
);
view?.render({});
});

return (

` | | create | (el: HTMLElement) => WidgetView | | | render | (props: Record) => Promise | | | unmount() | Promise | | | update | (props: Record) => Promise | | | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | config | Object | N | | basic config of widget | | shopId | string | Y | '123456' | seller id, used for event tracking | | oecRegion | string | Y | 'US' | seller region, used for traffic scheduling | | appKey | string | Y | 'xxxxx' | authorized by the service market, used for authentication | | isvInfo | Object | Y | | ISV related information | | name | string | Y | 'OPEN_PLATFORM' | the name of ISV | | getToken | Promise | N | | promise method to get token | | token | string | Y | 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzUxMxxxxxxxx' | token | | expire_at | string | Y | '1703227531' | expiration | WidgetConfigProvider only exists in @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | config | Object | Y | | basic config of widget | | shopId | string | Y | '123456' | seller id, used for event tracking | | oecRegion | string | Y | 'US' | seller region, fill in the standard code of the country where the merchant is located, such as 'US', 'GB', 'ID', and so on. | | appKey | string | Y | 'xxxxx' | authorized by the service market, used for authentication | | isvInfo | Object | Y | | ISV related information | | name | string | Y | 'xxxxx' | the name of ISV | | getToken | Promise | Y | | promise method to get token | | token | string | Y | 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzUxMxxxxxxxx' | token | | expire_at | string | Y | '1703227531' | expiration | | remotes | []Object | Y | | | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | | preloadWidgetNames | string[] | N | ['@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer'] | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | RemoteWidget only exists in @tiktokshop/widget-kit-react | Properties | Type | Require | Sample | Properties description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | name | string | Y | '@tiktokshop-widget/product:optimizer' | Integrated widget name, provided by the open platform | | className | string | N | '' | dom node's classname | | style | CSSProperties | N | `JSON
{
"width":100
}
` | dom node's style | | options | Record | N | | Configuration of incoming widget components | ```JSON export interface WidgetComponent { create: (el: HTMLElement) => WidgetView; } ``` ```JSON export interface WidgetView { render: (props: Record) => Promise; unmount(): Promise; update: (props: Record) => Promise; } ``` # Error message list | **Error message** | **description** | | --- | --- | | Please call init first | You need to initialize [init](https://bytedance.larkoffice.com/docx/VmDKdqmlCokkwcx5srecegJongc#doxcnZJv54tgHadJdfTbSydf4nc) first before using it | | Current name configuration not found | Incorrect resource loading, please check if the resource is abnormal | | | | # FAQ If you encounter problems while using the SDK, you can refer to this document to solve them. 1. The widget page fails to load, and the interface for obtaining the token repeatedly initiates a request.
solution: Check the return value and parameters of the interface /api/v1/seller/widget/get, usually because the token is not passed in. Check the return value of getToken in the code and ensure that the following data is returned.
```SQL if (res?.code === 0) { return res?.data;//The token interfaces of different access parties return different data structures, and the ways of obtaining data are different here. } ``` 2. Interface/api/v1/seller/widget/get error list | error code | error message | reason | | --- | --- | --- | | 36017010 | Widget domain not match | The domain name configured in the whitelist does not match the actual one. | | 36017005 | Widget Token Is Expired | The widget token has expired | | 36017006 | Widget token is invalid | The widget token was sent incorrectly | | 36017008 | app_key is not match | app_key is not match | | 36017009 | Widget Token Shop Not Match | Your input shopid is not consistent with the shop info in widget. | | 36004003 | invalid client_key | Appkey whitelist is not configured. You need to provide the domain name and appKey to the open platform and configure the whitelist. | | I01008 | Traffic is invalid | The shop region is not matched with server room. In most cases, it was caused by unmatched shop_id and region. | 3. The error is reported as follows
Solution: The widget name is wrong, please refer to the integration documentation to check again.

detail.title: Quality engine incident reason code
detail.content:
For developers who have integrated with Quality Engine, when there are some incidents, developers need to sync incident reason by reason code of the list. It can help the system to identify risk order and A-LOC order with higher accuracy and then we can provide more efficient suggestions for sellers/developers to resolve the issues. And it also is very helpful to improve our system performance. To sync reason code, developers need: 1. Syncing enumeration of reason code on the list via Quality Engine data exchanging API. 2. Using codes on the list, any codes out of the list will be forbidden to sync by Quality Engine. 3. Using correct code, developers need to pay attention to the description of code and sync the most reasonable code for the specific incident. 4. Using the code which is suitable for the rule, every reason code has its suitable rules, developers need to follow the mapping relationship on the list. Reason Code List: 1. Reason codes for incident that there is no related order in DTC channel. (Orphan order) | Reason Category | Suitable for Rules | Reason Code | Orphan Reason Desc | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_TIKTOKSHOP_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED** | Seller revoked TikTok shop authorization for the App | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_UNINSTALLED_DTC_APP** | Seller uninstalled the App from the Channel platform | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_NOT_GRANT_DTC_PERMISSION** | Seller did not grant corresponding APIs permission of the Channel platform for App | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_DTC_STORE_UNAVAILABLE** | Seller's Channel store is unavailable | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_TIKTOKSHOP_STORE_INACTIVE** | Seller's TikTok shop store is inactive | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_DTC_NO_SKU** | No corresponding SKU found for seller's Channel products | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_DTC_ABNORMAL_PRODUCT_STATUS** | Abnormal product status on seller's Channel platform | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_DTC_PRODUCT_OUT_OF_STOCK** | Products on seller's Channel platform are out of stock | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_TIKTOKSHOP_ORDER_AMOUNT_ZERO** | Order amount in seller's TikTok shop orders is 0 | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_APP_OWE_FEE** | Seller used the App but did not renew or out of quota | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **SELLER_ABANDON_SYNC_TIKTOKSHOP_ORDER** | Seller opted not to synchronize TikTok shop orders | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **APP_MISSED_WEBHOOK** | App missed TikTok shop order webhooks | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **APP_ORDER_RETRIEVE_API_FAILED** | App failed to retrieve orders by calling TikTok shop API | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **APP_ORDER_RETRIEVE_API_NOT_MATCH_DTC_FIELD** | The order information retrieved by the App through the TikTok shop API is incomplete | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **APP_CALL_DTC_CREATE_ORDER_API_FAILED** | App failed to create orders by calling Channel API | | Orphan Order | R1/R2/A1 | **OTHER** | Other | 2. Reason code for incident that order is shipped in DTC channel but not shipped in TikTok Shop. | Reason Category | Suitable for Rules | Reason Code | Pre-RTS Desc | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER** | Invalid Tracking Number entered in DTC:
- tracking number has extra spaces or tabs
- tracking number is incorrect but accepted by DTC
TTS rejects this fulfillment | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_TRACKING_NUMBER** | Supported carrier by DTC but unsupported carrier in TTS
TTS rejects this fulfillment | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **ORDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_FULFILLMENT** | Package shipped in DTC but not TTS because TTS has a
cancellation or refund request for that order.
TTS rejects this fulfillment | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **FULFILL_UNIT_OR_ORDER_NUMBER_NOT_COMBINED_CORRECTLY** | Package or Order fulfillment call to TTS failed because
the tracking number has been used in another order without
combining orders. | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **FULFILL_UNIT_OR_ORDER_NUMBER_NOT_FOUND** | Package or Order fulfillment call to TTS failed because seller
combined or split order in TTS or the DTC before fulfillment.
TTS rejects this fulfillment | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **FULFILLMENT_FAILURE_DUE_TO_RATE_LIMIT** | Package or Order fulfillment call to TTS failed because app
rate limit was exceeded and there was no retry | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **FULFILLMENT_FAILURE_DUE_TO_NO_RETRY_LOGIC** | order fulfillment call was made for this order from the connector app
but TTS system was down and threw an internal error. Order fulfillment
was not retried by the connector app | | Pre-RTS | A3/R5/R6 | **FULFILLMENT_FAILURE_DUE_TO_NO_API_CALL** | No order fulfillment call was made for this order from the connector |

## Prerequisites
If you are a developer who has developed Apps for TikTok Shop, you can download TikTok Shop API SDK on the [TikTok Shop Partner Center console](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/openlearn/api-sdk).
If you are a developer new to TikTok Shop, you must [create a TikTok Shop App](create-tts-app-oauth-client) before downloading the SDK on the [console](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/openlearn/api-sdk).
## Download SDK
The SDK includes APIs of the combined collection of access scopes corresponding to your effective apps. The effective apps and combined access scopes, private API scopes included, are listed on the page. Confirm the API access scopes included in the SDK before downloading the SDK.
